brief:
The Electronic Intifada published a personal reflection on loss and enduring connection, framing grief as an expression of continuing love. The piece examines how Mohammed Hamo's influence remained transformative even after his death, suggesting that bonds forged in life retain their power to shape those left behind.

The reflection considers how loss does not sever the relationship between the living and the dead, but instead transforms it into a different form of presence. The author describes Hamo's impact as something that persisted beyond mortality, shaping decisions and perspectives in ways that grief itself became inseparable from love.
dek: Mohammed Hamo never failed to change my life for the better, even after his death.
title: Grief as love persists after Mohammed Hamo's death
